_comment: Playable races, from the Blade & Sigil design doc. 'ability_bonus' adds to the rolled score. 'save_bonus' adds to all saving throws (the dwarven trait). 'detect_bonus' adds flat % to secret-door/trap detection (the wood-elf trait; the doc doesn't give a number — 10 is a proposal, tune freely). | HALF-ELF (Ranger doc v1, 2026-08-29): 'floating_bonus': 1 = +1 to ONE ability the player picks at creation (party.json: "bonus_ability": "dex"); detect_bonus 5 is the doc's 'lesser knack' proposal.

half_elf.name: Half-Elf
traits: A lesser knack for secret doors
